visual.general_description: Four stacked pairs of evoked-potential traces on a shared 0 to 500 ms axis, labelled before CI activation and 3 months, 9 months and 5 years after CI.
visual.detailed_description: Four horizontal bands are stacked top to bottom, each holding two irregular black traces, plotted against one shared x axis labelled ms with ticks every 50 from 0 to 500. Text at the right of each band reads “Before CI activation”, “3 months after CI”, “9 months after CI” and “5 years after CI”. Small, partly legible device channel labels sit at the left end of every trace. In the first band neither trace carries a marker. In the 3 months band the upper, darker trace has its tallest peak at its highest point topped by an arrow, a small circle and the printed label “P1”, and the lower trace has a broad hump with a tiny label that is too small to read. In the 9 months band the upper trace has a peak, earlier than in the 3 months band, with the “P1” marker, and the lower trace a lower peak without a readable label. In the 5 years band the upper trace has a still earlier peak with the “P1” marker, and the lower trace has a peak at a similar position with a small unlabelled dot. No amplitude axis, scale bar or other numeric values are printed.
